##### Project general facts

Samana Barari Views 2 by Samana Developers is the second phase of the Barari Views residential project. The development combines modern design with comfortable layouts and offers a range of apartments, from studios to 3-bedroom residences, suited to different lifestyles and family needs.

A key feature of the project is the private pools available in selected apartments, giving residents their own space to relax and unwind at home. This adds a sense of privacy and exclusivity to everyday living, combining the comfort of a home with the feel of a private retreat.

The apartments feature contemporary interiors with a soothing neutral colour palette. Each unit is delivered fully finished, with a kitchen equipped with Teka appliances, including a refrigerator, stove and microwave, as well as a washing machine. The apartments also come with a furniture pack tailored to the size of the unit, allowing residents to move in with minimal additional setup.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Majan, a district of around 1.5 million sq m in the heart of the Dubailand area. Majan is a developing community that combines residential complexes, iconic towers, hotels and mixed-use developments, making it attractive both for living and for investment.

The area is located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and close to Al Ain Road. These major routes provide convenient access to other parts of Dubai, as well as to Sharjah, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain.

Residents of Majan benefit from nearby schools, business and shopping centres, medical facilities, sports venues and major leisure attractions. The combination of developed infrastructure and more accessible prices compared to waterfront and central areas makes the district popular among both homeowners and tenants.
